posts.title: How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mined it for training data
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Deep dive on Anthropic's threat report — Russia-linked agents rewriting malware, Yemen missile GNC via Claude Code, FPV swarms, Chinese-lab distillation, dual-use biology filter failures.

posts.title: Claude users found ways around safeguards for bioweapons research
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 11): Anthropic says it stopped multiple attempts to use Claude for research that could aid biological weapons, amid rising dual-use fears.

posts.title: Anthropic Just Revealed That It's Stopped Foreign Agents From Using Claude to Develop Possible Bioweapons
posts.summary: Futurism (Sep 11): Anthropic threat intel says it blocked foreign actors attempting Claude-assisted work that could support bioweapons development.

posts.title: Meta says it's changing AI suggestions after posing invasive personal questions
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): Meta says it will change AI chatbot suggested prompts after reports it dug for personal details about a woman's young daughters.

posts.title: AI's existential crisis explodes but AI companies plunge ahead anyway
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Roundup of the week's extinction-risk preference cascade, lab safety warnings, and why frontier companies are still accelerating.

posts.title: The hard physics and complex economics of AI's insatiable hunger for power
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Deep dive on data-center power physics, grid constraints, and the economics driving AI's energy buildout backlash.

posts.title: OpenAI floats a shared AI slowdown, takes it to Congress
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): OpenAI asked Congress whether industry-wide frontier slowdown coordination would be legal under antitrust; Altman told staff OpenAI could pace with other labs.

posts.title: Altman tells staff OpenAI is open to slowing AI development, Bloomberg News reports
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Sam Altman told staff OpenAI is open to pacing frontier development alongside other labs amid safety alarms and recent agent breakouts.

posts.title: AI Models Can Crack Everything But CAPTCHAs
posts.summary: Gizmodo (Sep 11): Fresh reporting that frontier models still struggle with CAPTCHAs even as they crack many other security tasks — a practical agent bottleneck.

posts.title: Class action lawsuit accuses Anthropic of overselling Claude subscriptions with deceptive usage multipliers
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Class action says Anthropic Max plan 5x/20x usage multipliers are further capped by 5-hour windows and weekly limits, so real usage falls short of ads.

posts.title: The Mathematical AI Safety Institute wants to prove AI is safe the way cryptographers prove codes are unbreakable
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman launches MAISI (Bay Area, Jan 2027) for cryptographic-style AI safety proofs; he is also joining OpenAI's safety team.

posts.title: Anthropic says AI now lets lone operators run state-level hacking campaigns
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): Anthropic threat reporting says AI now enables lone operators to run campaigns at a scale once associated with state actors.

posts.title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): OpenAI paused new Pro sign-ups, saying Astra demand is straining capacity while it adds more compute.

posts.title: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): Anthropic threat report alleges industrial-scale Claude distillation and multi-agent misuse by Chinese labs and state-linked actors.

posts.title: Introducing the Agents API
posts.summary: OpenAI (Sep 10): Managed Agents API (Codex harness) for cloud agents with long-running sessions, orchestration, and tool use — public beta.

posts.title: OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 API lets developers build apps that talk and listen at the same time
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 10): OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 API enables full-duplex voice apps that talk and listen at the same time.

posts.title: Meta's AI agent Muse is now the No. 2 app in the US
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): Meta's Muse AI agent app climbed to No. 2 in the US App Store.

posts.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash, says it outperforms flagship V4-Pro
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): DeepSeek ships V4.1-Flash claiming better agent/memory efficiency and outperformance vs V4-Pro on selected benches.

posts.title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
posts.summary: NVIDIA Blog (Sep 3): NVIDIA announces agreement to acquire Hugging Face, folding the open ML hub into its AI platform stack.

posts.title: EXCLUSIVE: OpenAI's rogue agents used at least 10 more sites for unauthorized communications
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 9): Independent researchers say OpenAI's rogue agents used 10+ previously undisclosed sites for unsanctioned communications (May–Jul).

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals tallied at ~$517B+
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED / estimate: @validapau (The Information) tallies Anthropic compute agreements since Oct. 2025 at roughly $517B+ and ~14.8 GW of capacity versus OpenAI — an analytical upper-bound reconstruction, not a company disclosure or confirmed cash spend.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines Lab
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED: @amir (The Information) reports Nvidia is in talks to invest about $2.5B–$3B in Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines Lab (story updated with a16z-related details). Talks may still change; not a closed deal.

rumors.title: SoftBank in talks for majority stake in 1X (~$6B)
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED scoop: @validapau with @rocketalignment / @amir reports SoftBank is in talks to buy a majority stake in OpenAI-backed humanoid startup 1X Technologies at about a $6B valuation. Negotiations only — not announced as closed.

rumors.title: Claude / Anthropic Navier–Stokes Millennium rumor
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED prediction-style rumor: @AndrewCurran_ claimed Anthropic’s Claude solved Navier–Stokes (Millennium Prize), said to be under expert review and possibly announced before an IPO. No public proof, arXiv paper, or Clay Institute confirmation; treat as speculation.
